title: GitHub - vivan1211/opengp: Open-source AI intelligence platform for private equity — cited RAG chat over your data room, portfolio analytics, AI model builder, meeting transcription & LP inbox. Self-hosted in your own AWS (full Terraform). AGPL-3.0 alternative to Rogo / Hebbia.
excerpt: Open-source AI intelligence platform for private equity — cited RAG chat over your data room, portfolio analytics, AI model builder, meeting transcription & LP inbox. Self-hosted in your own AW...
content_html:
OpenGP is a self-hosted, multi-tenant intelligence platform for private-equity firms, fund managers, and family offices — an open-source alternative to Rogo, Hebbia, and BlueFlame. Every AI answer is grounded in your documents with clickable citations, and everything runs in your own AWS account: your data never leaves your cloud.

What it does

  • Cited AI chat (RAG) — ask questions across your data room and portfolio; every figure links to the exact passage it came from. Click a citation, see the source page.
  • Data room — fund/transaction document management with server-side parsing (OCR + tables), chunking, embeddings, and hybrid retrieval (pgvector + full-text + rerank).
  • Portfolio analytics — deal explorer, MOIC/IRR/DPI KPIs, sector and geography breakdowns, and an AI chart builder over your live portfolio data.
  • Model Builder — describe an analysis ("model portfolio MOIC if sector weights shift") and it writes and runs real code in an isolated sandbox, returning editable Excel models.
  • Transaction reports — cited deal summaries generated from the data room, with custom report types.
  • Meeting intelligence — a meeting bot joins your calls, transcribes, detects questions live, and answers them grounded in your fund data.
  • LP inbox — email a question to your workspace's inbox address and get a cited draft answer; LP emails get suggested replies (the AI never emails LPs directly).
  • News & outreach — tracked-entity news with LLM relevance classification, plus LinkedIn outreach orchestration.
  • Multi-tenant & white-label — workspaces with per-workspace branding, roles (admin / analyst / viewer), and Postgres row-level security separating every tenant.
Cited answers Meeting live-assist
Model Builder Data room

Built for the enterprise, on AWS

This is not a demo app — it's the production architecture we ran commercially, open-sourced:

  • Aurora PostgreSQL (Serverless v2) with pgvector + full-text search, ~96 row-level-security policies enforcing tenant isolation at the database layer
  • Amazon Bedrock for document parsing (Bedrock Data Automation), embeddings (Cohere Embed v4), and reranking (Cohere Rerank 3.5) — plus bring-your-own model keys per workspace, routed per feature (chat, reports, transcription, news) via a KMS-encrypted key vault
  • Cognito authentication with TOTP MFA, KMS encryption, CloudTrail audit trail, private S3 buckets with server-side key reconstruction (no presigned-key confusion)
  • The entire stack is Terraform (infra/terraform/) — ~77 resources, deployable into your own account with four variables
  • CI on every PR: build + tests (2,200+), dependency audit, secret scan, SAST, and a gate that bans direct DB access from the browser

Get started

QUICKSTART.md walks zero-to-running in ~half a day — including the first-workspace bootstrap script. The short version:

git clone https://github.com/vivan1211/opengp.git
cd opengp && npm install && npm test          # everything runs locally except AWS services

cd infra/terraform
cp backend.hcl.example backend.hcl            # point at your state bucket
terraform init -backend-config=backend.hcl
terraform plan                                 # review!
terraform apply

Then follow docs/DEPLOYMENT.md to build the Docker images (CodeBuild → ECR) and roll them onto the app server, and docs/aws-migration/AWS-SETUP.md for the full service-by-service reference. Database schema lives in supabase/migrations/ (plain SQL, applied with psql; the directory name is historical).

docs/aws-migration/CLOUDFLARE-EDGE.md Optional Cloudflare edge (built, documented, currently off)

In-app, the Product info pages (/changelog) document the architecture and security model interactively — the architecture diagram above is a screenshot of it.

Positioning

Tools like Rogo, Hebbia, and BlueFlame AI prove the demand for AI-native workflows in private markets — but they're closed SaaS: your fund data lives on their infrastructure, priced per seat. OpenGP is the same category of product with the opposite deployment model: AGPL-3.0 licensed, self-hosted in your own AWS account, with your own model keys. Fork it, brand it, extend it.

Status & lineage

OpenGP was built as a commercial platform for a European private-equity workspace and open-sourced in August 2026 with all customer data, branding, and identifiers removed (the git history begins at the open-source release for that reason). It shipped to production; it is no longer actively developed by the original author. Issues and PRs are welcome — serious fork/maintainer interest doubly so.

License

AGPL-3.0. You can use, modify, and self-host OpenGP freely — including commercially. If you offer it to others as a service, the AGPL requires you to share your modifications.

content_html_zh:
OpenGP 是一个面向私募股权公司、基金经理和家族办公室的自托管、多租户智能平台，是 Rogo、Hebbia 和 BlueFlame 的开源替代品。 每个人工智能答案都基于您的文档并带有可点击的引用，并且一切都在您自己的 AWS 帐户中运行：您的数据永远不会离开您的云。

它的作用

  • 引用人工智能聊天 (RAG) — 在您的数据室和投资组合中提出问题；每个数字都链接到它来自的确切段落。 单击引用，查看源页面。
  • 数据室 - 基金/交易文档管理，具有服务器端解析（OCR + 表）、分块、嵌入和混合检索（pgvector + 全文 + 重新排序）。
  • 投资组合分析 — 交易浏览器、MOIC/IRR/DPI KPI、行业和地理细分，以及基于实时投资组合数据的 AI 图表生成器。
  • 模型生成器 — 描述分析（“如果行业权重发生变化，则对投资组合 MOIC 进行建模”），并在隔离的沙箱中编写和运行真实代码，返回可编辑的 Excel 模型。
  • 交易报告——引用数据室生成的交易摘要，并具有自定义报告类型。
  • 会议智能——会议机器人加入您的通话、转录、实时检测问题，并根据您的基金数据回答问题。
  • LP 收件箱 — 通过电子邮件将问题发送到您工作区的收件箱地址并获取引用的草稿答案； LP 电子邮件会得到建议回复（AI 不会直接向 LP 发送电子邮件）。
  • 新闻和外展——跟踪实体新闻与法学硕士相关性分类，加上 LinkedIn 外展编排。
  • 多租户和白标签 — 具有每个工作空间品牌、角色（管理员/分析师/查看者）的工作空间，以及分隔每个租户的 Postgres 行级安全性。
引用的答案 会议实时协助
模型生成器 资料室

在 AWS 上专为企业打造

这不是一个演示应用程序 - 这是我们在商业上运行的开源生产架构：

  • Aurora PostgreSQL（无服务器 v2），具有 pgvector + 全文搜索，约 96 行级安全策略在数据库层强制实施租户隔离
  • Amazon Bedrock 用于文档解析 (Bedrock Data Automation)、嵌入 (Cohere Embed v4) 和重新排名 (Cohere Rerank 3.5) - 加上每个工作区自带的模型密钥，通过 KMS 加密的密钥保管库按功能（聊天、报告、转录、新闻）进行路由
  • 使用 TOTP MFA 进行 Cognito 身份验证、KMS 加密、CloudTrail 审核跟踪、具有服务器端密钥重建的私有 S3 存储桶（无预签名密钥混淆）
  • 整个堆栈是 Terraform (infra/terraform/) — 约 77 个资源，可通过四个变量部署到您自己的帐户中
  • 每个 PR 上的 CI：构建 + 测试（2,200+）、依赖性审计、秘密扫描、SAST 以及禁止从浏览器直接访问数据库的门

开始使用

QUICKSTART.md 在大约半天的时间内从零开始运行——包括第一个工作区引导脚本。 简短版本：

git clone https://github.com/vivan1211/opengp.git
cd opengp && npm install && npm test          # everything runs locally except AWS services

cd infra/terraform
cp backend.hcl.example backend.hcl            # point at your state bucket
terraform init -backend-config=backend.hcl
terraform plan                                 # review!
terraform apply

然后按照 docs/DEPLOYMENT.md 构建 Docker 映像 (CodeBuild → ECR) 并将其滚动到应用程序服务器上，并按照 docs/aws-migration/AWS-SETUP.md 获取完整的服务参考。 数据库模式位于supabase/migrations/（普通SQL，与psql一起应用；目录名称是历史名称）。

文档

Doc 里面有什么
QUICKSTART.md 零到跑半天，按顺序
DEVELOPMENT.md Monorepo 布局、构建/测试命令、陷阱
文档/部署.md 部署 Runbook + 预部署安全检查表
文档/aws-migration/AWS-SETUP.md 每项 AWS 服务，端到端
基础设施/terraform/README.md IaC：什么是编纂的，什么是手动操作的，如何应用
文档/暂停和恢复.md 使堆栈脱机/将其恢复（闲置时省钱）
文档/aws-migration/CLOUDFLARE-EDGE.md 可选的 Cloudflare Edge（已构建、已记录、当前关闭）

在应用程序内，产品信息页面 (/changelog) 以交互方式记录架构和安全模型 - 上面的架构图是它的屏幕截图。

定位

Rogo、Hebbia 和 BlueFlame AI 等工具证明了私募市场对人工智能原生工作流程的需求，但它们是封闭式 SaaS：您的基金数据存储在它们的基础设施上，按席位定价。 OpenGP 是同一类别的产品，但具有相反的部署模型：AGPL-3.0 许可，在您自己的 AWS 账户中自托管，并具有您自己的模型密钥。 分叉它、品牌化、扩展它。

身份与血统

OpenGP 是作为欧洲私募股权工作空间的商业平台而构建的，并于 2026 年 8 月开源，删除了所有客户数据、品牌和标识符（因此，git 历史记录从开源版本开始）。 已交付生产；原作者不再积极开发。 欢迎提出问题和 PR——认真的分叉/维护者兴趣更是如此。

执照

AGPL-3.0。 您可以自由地使用、修改和自行托管 OpenGP——包括商业用途。 如果您将其作为服务提供给其他人，AGPL 要求您共享您的修改。
